title: Knight's Code
summary: Public TOTJO text included here for reflection and study.
bodyMarkdown:
A Knight is sworn to valour
{pronoun:possessive} heart knows only virtue
{pronoun:possessive} blade defends the helpless.
{pronoun:possessive} word speaks only truth.
{pronoun:possessive} shield shelters the forsaken.
{pronoun:possessive} courage gives hope to the despairing.
{pronoun:possessive} justice undoes the wicked.
{pronoun:possessive} image brings peace.
{pronoun:possessive} code breaks the darkness,
{pronoun:possessive} legend brings light
